title.rendered: Facebook Town Hall Meetings (Live Stream Events) – May 1 and 8, 6-6:45pm

content.rendered: Join us for our upcoming live stream Facebook Town Hall Meetings on the topic of proposed Measure #34-323. We will have two live stream events, May 1 and May 8, 6:00-6:45pm on both dates. Visit us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/sherwoodschooldistrict88J to tune in!
